props.description: Commands to search. Disabled items are never shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the dialog; defaults to the localized "Command palette".

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description of the palette; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search input; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; defaults to the localized "No matching results".

props.name: shortcutLabel
props.description: Shortcut hint rendered as `<kbd>` next to the title, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k" (Cmd+K on
macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere). Modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option.

props.name: maxResults
props.description: Maximum number of results shown

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom search, e.g. to rank results by match quality. Receives the
enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the
matching items in display order (then capped at `maxResults`). By
default, items whose group, title, description or keywords contain the
query (case-insensitive) are kept in `items` order.

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the results list; defaults to the localized "Command results".

props.name: enterLabel
props.description: Key hint shown at the end of the search input; defaults to the localized "Enter".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class of the dialog panel (a `class` attribute works too).

props.name: theme
props.description: Theme of the subtree (`v-model:theme`). Root default: `"auto"`

props.name: palette
props.description: Color palette (light / dark / system themes only); `null` for none

props.name: persist
props.description: Root only: persist theme and palette in cookies.

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the built-in texts

props.name: preset
props.description: Design preset (brings its palette unless `palette` is set)

props.name: gap
props.description:
Gap between items: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens
(`2` -> `var(--space-2)`), other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment (`align-items`); unset when omitted

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution (`justify-content`); unset when omitted

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps items onto multiple lines

props.name: separator
props.description:
Rendered between every two items (not before the first or after the
last), e.g. `"·"`; the `separator` slot renders any content (a vertical
`Divider`). Empty children (`v-if` comments) do not get a separator.

props.name: attached
props.description:
Joins the items into one attached group (e.g. a segmented row of buttons):
no gap, shared borders and outer-only corner radii. The group gets
`role="group"` unless a role is given; label it with `aria-label`.
